description.value: Bikes For All is a full-service bicycle shop operating two Lower Mainland locations, with this branch in New Westminster. Experienced mechanics can work on any brand of bicycle, and the shop stocks an unusually broad range of touring-oriented inventory including bags, panniers, racks, and a dedicated Touring/Bike Packing category in both new and used bikes. A rentals offering and e-bike service round out what is available to cyclists passing through.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website identifies '924 12th St, New Westminster, BC' as the second/branch location of Bikes For All, matching the OSM address '924 Twelfth Street' — however the OSM community field incorrectly states 'North Vancouver'; coordinates (49.2127913, -122.9372635) are consistent with New Westminster, not North Vancouver. The website documents full mechanical services, a Rentals menu category, Touring/Bike Packing inventory, and explicit e-bike service acceptance, providing positive evidence for several amenity fields. No pump, washroom, or charging amenities are mentioned on the website.
concerns: OSM community field states 'North Vancouver' but the website explicitly identifies 924 12th St as the New Westminster second store; OSM coordinates (49.2127913, -122.9372635) are geographically consistent with New Westminster, not North Vancouver — the community tag is wrong.
OSM record has no phone number; the branch phone 236-428-2176 was sourced from the website's front-page second-location callout.

This is a branch/secondary location — the primary store is at 112 E 7th Ave, Vancouver, BC (604-872-4534). A separate OSM record likely exists or should exist for the main store; check for duplicates.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate full-service bike shop with mechanic staff, broad touring inventory, e-bike service, and rentals — all directly valuable to touring cyclists. The New Westminster branch is a real, active location despite the OSM community metadata error.

Touring parts stocked.detail: Website lists 'Touring/Bike Packing' as a used-bike category and 'Touring/Steel' under Gravel/Road new bikes; accessory categories include Bags & Panniers and front/rear Racks

E-bike service.detail: Bike service page states 'Please bring your dual suspension and electric bikes into the store for a labour quote.'

Bike rentals.detail: Website main navigation includes a 'Rentals' category listed alongside Bike Service and other primary sections

wow_evidence: bags, panniers, racks, and a dedicated Touring/Bike Packing category in both new and used bikes
